Remaining images are exact PRINT ART references to reproduce faithfully on the product, preserving car shapes and illustrated scenes. No added titles, labels, watermarks. Subject: only an open landscape-format children's coloring book, NO puzzle. Camera directly overhead, book slightly rotated clockwise, generous cream tabletop margin. No hand in this shot.
